ranking_policy: Campaign direction: Lejan #1 fashion/everyday; Vivobarefoot running winner. Editorial ranking, not a verified performance fact. Disclosed campaign focus.
image: Existing original AI-generated generic featured image retained, labelled as such; no claim of product photography.

reviews.factual: Checked official model pages, materials, use, sizing and six live variant endpoints. No prices or first-hand tests. Lejan ranked for urban wear; Vivobarefoot is the running category choice.
reviews.editorial: Reviewed Spain vocabulary, campaign disclosure, prolonged standing on hard floors, model tradeoffs, travel, children, occupational requirements and cautious gradual adaptation.
reviews.seo: Reused sole matching canonical, synchronized update dates, checked H1, Open Graph, 2361 words, 10 ranked models, 0 article anchors, five matching FAQs and Article/Breadcrumb schema, image, blog and sitemap in Eleventy output.

conflicts: Lejan and Freet static availability labels conflict with live variant data. Public Shopify variant responses show orderable sizes; no stock counts published.
